info.name: MEGA Public CRM Lead Leads Webhooks API

description.content: Server-to-server API to pull leads, push leads (single + bulk), and manage lead webhooks for your MEGA CRM. Authenticate with an admin-issued Personal Access Token (`Authorization: Bearer mega_...`) plus the `x-customer-id` header. These are secret-key endpoints — call them from your backend, never from a browser.
